description: Get ranking snapshots for a player by providing their player ID. Each entry includes the ranking type (official/race/elo/earnings), position, points and diffs against the previous snapshot. For type `elo` the `points` field carries the Elo rating, so the series is the evolution of the rating over time. For type `earnings` the `points` field carries the prize money earned in the season, in the currency stated in `currency`. Without date filters returns the latest entry per type; with date filters returns the weekly historical series in that range. To get the player ID, use the "search-players" tool.

after_date.description: Start date of the historical series (YYYY-MM-DD).

before_date.description: End date of the historical series (YYYY-MM-DD).

player_id.description: The ID of the player to get rankings for.

type.description: Filter by ranking type. Omit to return all of them.

name: list-player-rankings
